status: Labels map the pre-author public criteria; no new acceptance bar.

criteria.C1: Every covered path has an actual read-based, file-specific useful disposition.
criteria.C2: Assertions distinguish implementation, documentation/declaration, inference and gaps.
criteria.C3: Source identities, paths and exact quote evidence support claims.
criteria.C4: Contracts, failures, relations and maintenance implications are useful at the layer under review. The first wave evaluates L1.
criteria.C5: Test source, old reviews and docs are never current execution.
criteria.C6: Ownership, exclusions and authorized external scope are preserved.
criteria.C7: No secrets, private evaluation or session material in the candidate.

corrections: Both same judges must re-evaluate exact changed bytes.
